description: Frontier patrols, sieges and battlegrounds from Living Server, rewritten.

lines.text: A good Minstrel in the frontier is worth three swords.
Every Infiltrator out there swears the last kill was his.
Realm ranks come slow but every one feels earned.
Heh, one day all the relics will sit in Albion keeps where they belong.
The Hibs mez everything that moves and call it tactics.
Mids travel in packs, like wolves.
Our Clerics keep the line standing, the Hibs know to hunt them first.
First rule of the frontier, guard the healers. Second rule, see first rule.
Every realm thinks the other two are teamed up, we are just right about it.
What do you think, are Mids or Hibs worse in a keep fight?
Nothing makes me prouder than Albion banners on a keep wall.
The frontier is where you learn who your real friends are.
Albs hold keeps like nobody else can, it is in our blood.
I like a small Alb group roaming the hills, no zerg needed.
Hibs build their keeps out of flowers, explains a lot.
The Hibs sent a Lurikeen to scout once, we stepped on him by accident.
Albion holds the line when it counts, the songs will say so.
Quiet out here, the Hibs must be napping.
Every tree out here might be a Nightshade, keep moving.
Nothing happening out here, which is the scariest part.
The wind on these hills bites right through plate.
Battlegrounds are where Albion learns to fight.
Stay near the Clerics, the Hibs come for them first.
Young Albion army doing us proud out here.
They are at {keep}, every Alb who can hold a sword is welcome.
The Mid zerg is not a zerg, it is a family reunion.
Albs build walls, Hibs build hedges, we build rams.
Give me a Troll with a hammer and a good healer and I will take any door.
The Albs and Hibs talk tough until the drums start.
Realm points taste better when an Alb dies complaining.
Hibs mez everything and then run behind their pets.
The relics will all come north one day, mark my words.
A good healer in the frontier is worth more than a bag of gold.
Nothing warms my heart more than a Midgard banner on a keep wall.
I like a small Mid group roaming the snow, no zerg needed.
Albs pray before a fight, Hibs sing, we just charge.
Every realm says the Mids zerg. Every realm wishes it had our numbers.
A Skald with speed and a healer with patience, that is a Mid army.
What do you think, are Albs or Hibs harder to fight in a keep?
Albion can keep its walls, Midgard has its axes.
How do you stop an Alb charge? Stand on a hill and wait for him to get tired.
Midgard fights harder than the other two put together, and the Albs know it.
Alb archers ruin every fight, I spend half of the frontier pulling arrows out.
Nothing like charging a keep door with a Troll on your left.
Cold wind out here, good fighting weather.
Quiet out here, the Albs must be polishing their armor.
Nobody near, just snow and silence.
The snow out here gets into my furs.
Battlegrounds are where Mids learn to love the zerg.
Stay close to the healers, the Albs go for them first.
Young Mid army doing us proud out here.
They are at {keep}, every Mid with an axe is welcome.
Albs charge, Mids roar, Hibs just win quietly.
The frontier without a Bard is a very long walk.
Mez first, ask questions later, the Hibernian way.
Mids always charge in screaming, our Enchanters love that.
Albs hide in their keeps like snails in the rain.
The frontier was ours long before anyone built walls on it.
Nothing feels as good as a mez landing on a whole Alb group.
Nothing lifts my heart like Hibernian banners on a keep wall.
Albs pray and Mids shout, we sing and win anyway.
Every realm calls us the mez realm. Every realm wishes it had our Enchanters.
What do you think, are Albs or Mids harder to fight in a keep?
Albion can keep its plate, Hibernia has its magic.
Mids bring Trolls, Albs bring plate, we bring a Lurikeen and nobody sees him coming.
An Alb tried to find a Nightshade once. He is still looking.
Hibernia fights smarter than the other two put together, and the Mids know it.
Alb Wizards ruin every fight, I spend half of the frontier dead.
Nothing like a Blademaster charge with a Bard singing behind you.
So quiet out here, the Albs must be lost again.
The grass out here hides too many things, stay close.
Mind the ridges, Alb archers like high ground.
Nobody near, just wind and birdsong.
The rain out here soaks my cloak.
Battlegrounds are where Hibs learn to mez under pressure.
Stay close to the Druids, the Albs go for them first.
First time in Abermenai, everyone is tiny and furious.
{enemyrealm} group heading for the Abermenai keep, anyone near?
Abermenai keep is ours for now, stay close to the door.
{enemyrealm} group headed for the keep in Thidranki, anyone near?
Thidranki keep door is down, everyone inside!
Got my first realm points in Thidranki, I get it now.
{enemyrealm} pushing the keep in Murdaigean, need bodies.
Holding the Murdaigean keep with six people, more welcome.
Murdaigean tonight? Short a couple for a group.
{enemyrealm} healers in Caledonia are hard to drop, focus them first.
Caledonia before the frontier, good practice for the big fights.
No more Murdaigean for me, 30 came too fast.
Nothing like the frontier on a busy night.
Caer Benowyc is under attack again, who is close?
Anyone heading to Caer Berkstead tonight?
Snowdonia is quiet, too quiet.
Bledmeer Faste is getting hit, defenders please.
Mjollner Faste still holding? Relic is there.
Uppland is calm, heading to the front instead.
Glenlock Faste fell an hour ago, retaking it?
Dun Crauchon needs defenders, enemies at the door.
Dun Dagda still ours? Relic check.
Cruachan Gorge is quiet tonight, good.
How many are there?
Again? They love that keep.
Who is leading the defense?
Cannot, mid pull, sorry.
On my way, hold the inner door.
Too low to help, sorry. Good luck.
Wish I could, I have a group going.
What is the door at?
How many defenders?
Rams or just zerg?
Good luck, take it fast before they wake up.
Go get it.
Coming, save me some realm points.
Realm points! Realm points!
Go go go, I want to see that keep in our colors.
Thanks defenders.
Nice save.
Ha, they will be back.
Who came for that one?
Well done all, rest up.
Good, they wasted their whole raid.
They always break on the inner door.
Held!
Nice hold.
Walls held, well done.
Thanks for coming out.
They gave up.
Ha, go home.
Good defense all.
They will try again later.
Doors held up.
Next time.
Regroup and try again?
Figures, they had the numbers.
Who led that one?
Not our turn I guess.
Rough, how long did it go?
Should have waited for more people.
Told you, experience is safer.
Too many of them.
Should've brought more.
Eh, worth a try.
Back to the keep I guess.
They had too many.
Close one.
Bah, out of time.
They held up good.
Well done realm!
Nice, grats all.
Thanks to everyone who went.
Hope we can hold it.
How long until they want it back?
About time we took that one.
Well done well done.
Ours again.
Nice, who was on it?
Took long enough.
That was quick.
Well done, now hold it.
Thanks all.
Go realm.
Let us keep this one a while.
Grats realm.
Free realm points tonight.
That one is always fun to take.
Nice push.
They will want that back.
Again?
Ugh, that one again.
Were there any defenders at all?
Of course.
We will take it back.
How did nobody see that coming?
Anyone forming to take it back?
Let us take it back tonight.
Oh well, not my keep.
Seriously?
Where was everyone.
Ugh, again.
Figures, again.
Bah.
Who was home?
They just walked in huh.
That keep never stays ours.
No defenders again I bet.
Wonderful.
And nobody called it?
Back to square one.
Great, there goes the realm points bonus.
Next time someone shout please.
Every night.
How did they get past the guards?
Who was guarding it?
That hurts.
Relic raid when?
We need it back fast.
Ugh, my spells already feel weaker.
Told everyone to watch the relic keep.
There goes my damage.
Oh no.
That is bad.
Great, now what.
Have to get that back.
Unreal.
Who let that happen.
Relic gone, wonderful.
We need a relic raid at once.
My damage.
Woohoo!
Huge, well done.
Nice! Who carried?
They will come for it hard.
Guard it well.
Free bonus, love it.
Grats realm, big one.
Now we hold it.
Woo relic!
Relic!
Nice carry.
They will be mad.
Big night.
Keep it safe this time.
Thanks carriers.
Love relic nights.
Got ganked by a stealther on the way in, again.
First night in the frontier, keep me alive please.
Realm points are slow tonight, quiet out there.
Chain-killed three {enemyrealm} stealthers tonight, feeling good.
Inc! Enemies on the road to {keep}.
Anyone near {keep}? I see a group headed that way.
They are hitting the door at {keep}, need defenders.
Keep defense at {keep}, every body helps.
Relic raid tonight? I would show up for that.
Out in the frontier, anyone want to run with me?
Stealthers out tonight, stick together.
{enemyrealm} eight-man roaming near {keep}.
Waiting at the portal keep for a group.
Almost got ganked at the bridge, close one.
Lots of {enemyrealm} at the mile gate, do not go alone.
Realm points are flowing tonight.
{keep} lord is still up, we have time.
Group up at the portal keep, safer that way.
Watch the hill near {keep}, archers up there.
Anyone know where the {enemyrealm} zerg went?
Got my first kill out here, heart still pounding.
Died to a {enemyrealm} archer I never even saw.
Frontier later?
Need a few more levels before I try the frontier.
Saving realm points for my next realm ability, so close.
Keep takes are fun but defending pays better realm points.
Thinking of trying the frontier for the first time, any tips?
Heard the {enemyrealm} took a relic, any truth to that?
My realm points are pitiful, need a good night out there.
Stealthers ruined my last frontier trip, trying again tonight.
Relic raid at some strange hour again, I bet.
